highlights: Line cuts can start and end off the part with a laser lead-in and lead-out, placed on each shape's scrap side. A new Blue Noise dither gives smoother midtones in portraits.
New free tools: a G-code Inspector, your computer's installed fonts, inch display units, and running a G-code file made in another program. Paid Pro licences keep working offline, like LightBurn's.

Machine Setup starts with one machine list, Start shows a compact confirm sheet you can edit in place, and the artwork hover readout shows power and speed. The Falcon A1 Pro's red pointer switches on with one tick.

Controllers behave more safely: jog cancel waits for the machine's reply, failed auto-connects and settings reads stay quiet, the safety notice and recovery card float over the canvas, and alarms are read per firmware.

Artwork lights up while you edit its settings. Trace an image already on the Registration Jig, Centre & LED keeps the pointer light on until LED off, and dither swatches appear wherever you pick a dither.
Bevel offsets keep square corners and line ends, Weld warns before enclosed shapes vanish, kerf offsets judge inner and outer edges more reliably, and the Artwork panel and hover pulse are calmer.
